task.goal: A daemon stores settings in JSON and keeps a .bak copy. write_config currently overwrites the live file before validation and can leave corrupt JSON or lose the last good settings. Fix write_config(path, data) and read_config(path) in config_store.py: validate JSON-serializable mapping input before touching files, preserve the previous valid config as .bak, replace the live file atomically, recover from a corrupt live file using a valid backup, and fail if both copies are bad. Run visible tests and validate.
